title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：technology　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 technology 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the engineer ① mastered the technology that no worker in the workshop would have described, and he said the mastering was the whole of the year. The ② technology, meaning the method itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; technology, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of technology in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ technology at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Technology, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the engineer said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the technology was the whole of the matter, meaning the progress and not the method. The ⑥ technology, meaning the progress and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; technology, he said, is either something you master or the only word that means both method and a progress. He said the progress is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ technology had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ technology of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of describing; technology, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ technology I remember is the technology described in the manual, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. ⑩ Technology, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being described; all technology, she said, is a progress that has agreed to look like method. She said the progress was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 技术；科技（指车间里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 技术；科技（指那门技术本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：master the technology 掌握这一门技术
D. n. 技术；科技（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 技术之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的技术之事）
F. n. 技术；科技（指说明书里写到、被描述的那一门）
G. n. 技术、进步（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 进步（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mastered the technology that no worker in the workshop would have described
The technology, meaning the method itself and not the lever
Every sort of technology in that workshop
the technology at the far bench
the technology was the whole of the matter
the technology had become a line in a manual
The technology of the whole thing

answers.why: master the technology 意为“掌握这一门技术”，1972 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯描述的一门技术做了一遍。
technology 意为“技术；科技”，指那门技术本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
technology 意为“技术；科技”，指车间里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
technology 意为“技术；科技”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
technology 意为“技术、进步”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门进步就是那件事的全部。
technology 意为“进步”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门技术，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
technology 意为“技术；科技”，指说明书里写到、被描述的那一门，到 1977 年这一门成了说明书里的一行。
technology 意为“技术之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的技术之事是一处车间和三个年头的描述。
technology 意为“技术；科技”，我记得的是说明书里描述过的那一门，1979 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一门。
technology 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，技术是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的技术。
